title: How to Disable or Avoid Intrusive AI Features Across Platforms and Applications
summary: A practical guide providing step-by-step instructions to disable or avoid intrusive AI features in various software, operating systems, and devices. The article covers methods for Adobe products, Google services, Apple Intelligence, Windows 11, browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), messaging apps (Slack, WhatsApp), and other platforms like Zoom and Yahoo Mail. It also includes additional resources for further AI removal and detection.
key_points: Instructions to disable AI in Adobe Acrobat/Reader on Windows and macOS.
Steps to turn off Gemini features on Android, including in Messages and other apps.
How to disable Apple Intelligence and Siri learning features on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
Methods to disable AI features in browsers like Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, including extensions and settings.
Guides to opt out of AI in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs) and DuckDuckGo search engine.
Disabling AI features in Slack, WhatsApp, and Zoom, including suggested replies and meeting transcriptions.
Steps to uninstall or disable Copilot in Windows 11, including in File Explorer, Notepad, and Office 365.
Additional tools and resources for removing AI features, such as O&O ShutUp 10 and Win11DeBloat.
Links to further reading on AI removal and detection, including the Library Freedom Project.
